baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fa-idha construction, the feminine verb at 80:33[2], and its event-subject at 80:33[3].
baseline_models.mechanism: The coming branch makes the clause a threshold rather than a static description: an event moves from futurity into occurrence, and the conditional frame suspends the consequences at the instant of arrival.

activation_trace.role: Coming and actual arrival supply the transition from an awaited possibility to an occurring threshold.

changed_reading.before: A loud event is simply announced.
changed_reading.after: The clause isolates the exact threshold at which the event becomes present and a new regime begins.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb جاءت at 80:33[2], read through a branch in which coming can carry presentation into view.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival can be heard not only as locomotion but as presentation: what comes makes something hitherto absent available for encounter. The event-subject therefore has a latent demonstrative force even before the context identifies what it exposes.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something turns the event's coming into an act of making a concealed reality encounterable.

changed_reading.before: The subject merely reaches a time or place.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival also presents a reality that had not yet stood openly before its hearers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coming verb at 80:33[2] and the structurally intense, branchless event noun at 80:33[3].
baseline_models.mechanism: A causative side branch of coming activates an asymmetry: ordinary arrivals can be accepted or avoided, but this arrival may drive its addressees into encounter. The form-distance keeps the reading exploratory, while the event's grammatical agency keeps it anchored.

activation_trace.role: Driving or compelling supplies the exploratory force by which arrival removes the option of remaining outside the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The event comes toward passive observers.
changed_reading.after: The event's coming may itself force observers into an encounter they cannot decline.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two people-centered arrivals precede the event's arrival: the blind man comes, and the striving, fearful seeker comes. One such arrival is met by turning away. Repetition transfers grammatical initiative from the neglected visitor to the final event, reversing who can control attention: the earlier arrival could be disregarded, whereas the later arrival cannot.

activation_trace.role: Actual arrival anchors the final event as the third and decisive member of the repeated coming sequence.
Turning away and withdrawal supply the earlier avoidable response that the final arrival reverses.
The blind man's concrete coming establishes the first human arrival whose claim on attention was mishandled.
The seeker's second coming makes arrival a deliberate refrain before the event itself comes.
Purposeful movement toward a sought object marks the earlier visitor's agency, which contrasts with the later event's agency over everyone else.

structural_cues: The exact verb جاء recurs at 80:2, 80:8, and 80:33, with the final occurrence shifting to a feminine event-subject.
The focus fa-idha marks a delayed reversal after the opening scene of selective attention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated arrivals, purposeful seeking, and an earlier turning-away; I infer that the last arrival reverses control of attention. A live alternative is that the repetition is only lexical cohesion without a social reversal.

changed_reading.before: The event is an isolated future arrival.
changed_reading.after: It answers the opening arrivals: the person who once controlled whom to face is now confronted by an arrival from which no one can turn away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is first available to whoever wills to remember; the focus arrival then shifts cognition from elective recollection to imposed encounter. The branch of compelled coming sharpens the event as the point where a mediated sign no longer depends on a hearer's willingness.

activation_trace.role: Compelled movement supplies the shift from optional reception to an unavoidable encounter, while remaining a form-distant activation.
A reminder as that which prompts recollection establishes the earlier, mediated mode of access.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the elective condition that the event's compelled arrival later removes.

structural_cues: 80:11-12 explicitly pair reminder with willing remembrance before the focus's fa-idha threshold.
The branchless focus root ص خ خ is used only as the structural cue of an intense event noun, not as a fabricated branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary remembrance and a later event arrival; I infer a closing of the voluntary-response interval. The alternative is that reminder and event remain parallel disclosures without the latter coercing cognition.

changed_reading.before: The event is another warning alongside the reminder.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival ends the phase in which recognition could remain an elective response to reminder and makes encounter compulsory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acoustic side branches lie latent inside the opening attention scene: self-sufficiency carries a voice/song branch, attending carries echo and the seat of hearing, and willing carries inclining the ear. Activated by the branchless sound-event noun in the focus, these cues recast the arrival as saturation of the very channel through which attention had been selectively allocated.

activation_trace.role: Arrival makes the acoustic saturation temporal and eventive rather than a free-floating sound motif.
Voice or song is a branch-distant acoustic image inside the socially privileged figure's self-sufficiency.
Returning echo turns selective attendance into a resonant channel that can be overtaken by a greater sound.
Inclining the hearing supplies the voluntary auditory posture whose selectivity the arriving event saturates.

structural_cues: The focus noun at 80:33[3] lacks a branch inventory and is therefore used only as a structural cue for the sound-event frame.
The opening scene repeatedly contrasts turning toward one claimant and being distracted from another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acoustic side branches and a structurally sonic focus noun; I infer that the final sound disables selective hearing. The live alternative is that these side branches are lexical accidents and the event's force is not specifically auditory.

changed_reading.before: The sound is merely very loud.
changed_reading.after: The sound arrives as total occupation of an attention channel that had earlier been managed, echoed, and selectively inclined.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered sequence removes life, places the human in a hidden depression, and then opens, spreads, or revives him. The focus repeats an idha threshold after that sequence, so the arriving event can be read as the operational hinge by which containment gives way to unfolding, not merely as noise accompanying an already complete scene.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the temporal hinge at which the prior hidden state can become an unfolded state.
Loss of force and life establishes the closed state from which the later transition proceeds.
Hiddenness and depression make burial a spatial containment rather than only a chronological marker.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the release geometry that the event's threshold can initiate.
Reviving the dead fixes the human transformation to which the broader opening image applies.

structural_cues: 80:21-22 form a death, burial, and conditional unfolding sequence before the focus.
The earlier ثم إذا and the focus فإذا create parallel transition frames.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies containment followed by revival/opening and then another idha threshold; I infer that the focus event functions as the hinge of release. The alternative is that revival and the focus arrival are distinct stages rather than trigger and transformation.

changed_reading.before: The event arrives after resurrection as an accompanying alarm.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival can mark the hinge by which buried hiddenness opens into revived, spread-out human presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human has not yet completed what was commanded; command carries a branch of sign or appointed time, and provision extends until a limit. The focus arrival therefore acts as a deadline: it converts the open state of 'not yet completed' into a closed state in which unfinished obligation can no longer be deferred.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence of the event supplies the deadline's arrival and closes mere futurity.
Completion, termination, and being finished define precisely what the human's 'not yet' leaves open.
A sign or appointed time gives command a latent temporal boundary rather than leaving obligation indefinitely open.
Extension that reaches its limit supplies the interval between unfinished command and arriving deadline.

structural_cues: The particle lamma at 80:23 leaves completion pending, while fa-idha at 80:33 introduces the event that ends the pending interval.
The provision sequence occupies the finite interval between noncompletion and arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies noncompletion, an appointed-time branch, finite extension, and arrival; I infer that arrival closes the performance window. A live alternative is that the event only reveals unfinished obligation without itself ending the opportunity to complete it.

changed_reading.before: The event is a catastrophe after a list of duties and provisions.
changed_reading.after: It is also the arriving deadline that hardens 'not yet fulfilled' into an irreversible unfinished record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, controlled downward flow and a deliberately opened earth produce growth and usable provision. Immediately after it, flight and tearing images move bodies apart. The event arrives as a phase reversal in one release-system: opening first integrates water, earth, and seed into life, then a second release disintegrates the human social formation into flight.

activation_trace.role: Arrival marks the switch-point between the productive and dispersive phases.
Pouring and downward flow supply the first controlled release that feeds formation.
Delivering water by irrigation makes the flow purposive and productive rather than chaotic.
Fissuring and opening the earth provide a productive breach through which life can emerge.
Plant emergence records the integrative result of the first flow-and-opening phase.
Enjoyable benefit names the stable usable yield that exists immediately before the reversal.
Agitated tearing and splitting supply the destructive counterpart to the earth's earlier productive opening.

structural_cues: 80:25-32 is a tightly ordered material production sequence ending immediately before fa-idha.
80:34 begins the human dispersal sequence immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies controlled flow, productive fissure, growth, provision, and later flight/tearing; I infer a single system changing phase at the focus arrival. The alternative is simple juxtaposition of provision and catastrophe with no shared release mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The event abruptly interrupts an unrelated catalogue of food.
changed_reading.after: It flips the same release logic that opened earth into life: productive integration becomes social tearing and dispersal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding benefit is an extended, retained means of use for humans and livestock. Its branches explicitly include reaching a limit; the following day is a bounded duration and a severe occurrence. The arrival therefore reads as expiration of usufruct rather than necessarily annihilation of the provided things: their user-oriented availability has reached its term.

activation_trace.role: Coming and occurrence instantiate the boundary at which the term of use expires.
Extension or elevation until a limit gives provision a finite temporal span.
Prolonged retention for enjoyment makes the pre-event world a held interval of use.
Livestock wealth fixes the benefit in actual dependents and possessions rather than abstract pleasure alone.
A day's severe occurrence names the bounded new condition that succeeds the expired interval of use.

structural_cues: The focus follows متاعا لكم ولأنعامكم without an intervening ayah.
80:34 appositionally identifies the consequence-frame as a day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benefit retained through extension, a limit, and the following bounded day; I infer expiration of access at the event's arrival. The alternative is that provision remains available materially but becomes irrelevant because each person is preoccupied.

changed_reading.before: The event destroys or interrupts material provision.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival first marks the expiry of provision's term as benefit-for-users, whether or not the material inventory itself vanishes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event is followed by flight from brother, parental origin, companion, and children; these are bonds, sources, companionships, and built extensions of the self. The causative side of coming is thereby sharpened: arrival forces each person out of relational shelter into a fully encompassing private concern.

activation_trace.role: Driving and compelling supply the event's exploratory agency in forcing individuation.
Flight gives the compelled encounter its immediate behavioral output: movement away from every refuge.
Bond or tether makes flight from the brother a rupture of attachment, not mere change of company.
Origin, gathering point, and place of return make departure from the mother a loss of the deepest relational refuge.
Close companionship and continuance supply the durable proximity that the event dissolves.
Building by joining parts lets children represent a constructed human formation that now comes apart.
Totality and enclosure make private concern comprehensive enough to exclude all relational claims.
A person's own matter or crisis supplies the individualized load that replaces shared bonds.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence moves concentrically through brother, mother, father, companion, and children.
Repeated possessive suffixes make each severed relation personally intimate before 80:37 isolates each individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flight, progressively intimate bonds, and all-consuming private concern; I infer that the event's arrival forces relational unbinding. The alternative is that arrival only precedes, rather than causes, the flight generated by each person's separate concern.

changed_reading.before: Everyone separately hears an overwhelming event.
changed_reading.after: The event comes as a compulsory individuation process, stripping away bond, origin, companionship, and constructed lineage until each stands inside a private matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with a managed facial contraction and ends with two classes of faces. Uncovering/light, surface manifestation, dusty residue, overpowering overlay, covering, and breached covering form a disclosure system. The focus arrival's presentation branch makes the event the hinge that transfers inward or managed conditions onto publicly legible surfaces.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting supplies the event's role in making concealed states stand visibly forth.
A face contracted by discomfort establishes the opening instance of an inward stance managed at the surface.
Removing a cover supplies the disclosure operation on the bright class of faces.
The face as front and facing surface provides the public register on which the event's results become readable.
Skin and outward surface make gladness a manifested condition rather than an inaccessible interior feeling.
Dust and earth-color supply the residue visibly borne by the contrasting class of faces.
Overtaking and overpowering turn darkness into an active overlay upon the face.
Covering names the concealed orientation that the facial overlay paradoxically exposes.
Deviation that breaches a covering explains why the covered condition can no longer remain privately screened.

structural_cues: A face-state opens the surah, while polarized face-states dominate 80:38-41 after the focus.
The event itself is grammatically the arriving subject between managed attention and involuntary visibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the face arc and branches of uncovering, surface appearance, overlay, covering, and breach; I infer that the arriving event mediates public disclosure. The alternative is that it merely precedes facial consequences produced by another judgment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The event is followed by unrelated descriptions of happy and distressed faces.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival presents hidden orientation at the bodily surface, ending the opening scene's ability to manage what the face shows and whom it faces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the competition-by-repeated-coming branch is idiomatic and narrower than ordinary جاء; it remains valid because the same root and exact verb recur in two human arrivals and the focus arrival. Downstream prose should frame it as an 'as if' contest for attention, not claim a literal lexical meaning of competition in 80:33.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb جاءت at 80:33[2] as the third occurrence of the coming root after 80:2 and 80:8.

activation_trace.role: Competing through repeated coming lets the focus arrival act as the arrival that finally wins command of attention.
The first human coming supplies one claimant in the repeated-arrival contest.
The second human coming intensifies repetition before the event becomes the final claimant.

changed_reading.before: Three uses of coming provide simple verbal repetition.
changed_reading.after: The arrivals can be carried as competing claims on attention, with the focus event becoming the arrival that cannot lose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because it activates rare hollow-water and wound-collection branches of coming across domains; it remains anchored in جاءت and is reinforced by packet images of pooled matter, burial-depth, fissure, and opening. Downstream prose must present it only as a pressure-and-release analogy, never as the lexical denotation of the focus event.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus coming verb at 80:33[2], with the event noun at 80:33[3] used only as a structural rupture cue.

activation_trace.role: A hollow where water gathers supplies the bounded accumulation geometry that precedes release.
Collected matter in a wound supplies the unsettling pressure image of accumulation reaching a breaking point.
A gathered mass reinforces accumulation before the focus threshold.
Hidden depth supplies the containing cavity in which the human state remains suppressed.
Fissure and opening provide the breach through which accumulated containment can fail.
Opening and spreading provide the released state after pressure breaks containment.

changed_reading.before: The event arrives externally upon the world.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its arrival resembles accumulated pressure reaching threshold and bursting the world's hidden enclosures open from within.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain botanical reading: branch images of emergence, a spathe splitting, first signs, and residue make faces resemble ripened or failed surfaces. It remains valid because the focus arrival is a temporal threshold between cultivation and facial manifestation. Downstream prose should use harvest or ripening only as a qualified analogy, not identify people with plants or replace the social reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The temporal coming at 80:33[2], positioned between the cultivation sequence and the appearing faces.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the ripening threshold at which prior formation becomes outwardly inspectable.
Plant emergence supplies the pre-focus developmental field from which the harvest analogy grows.
The splitting-open of spathe and early fruit lets laughter image a surface opening at maturity.
First signs or advance shoots make gladness the visible onset of an achieved condition.
A remainder left after what accompanied it has passed supplies the contrasting residue of a failed yield.

changed_reading.before: The cultivation catalogue and the later faces are separate scenes.
changed_reading.after: The event can be carried as a harvest-like threshold at which formed lives open on their faces as bright first-fruit or dusty remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because the ostrich-flight and group-dispersion image is a remote branch under the root occurring in 'your livestock'; it remains anchored by the immediate 80:32-34 sequence and the focus arrival between them. Downstream prose should call it a latent verbal foreshadowing, not treat أنعام as lexically meaning dispersed people here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus arrival at 80:33[2], exactly between provision for livestock and a person's flight.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the hinge that converts the pre-focus animal-provision field into post-focus human flight.
Ostrich flight and the dispersal of a group unexpectedly preload the motion that follows the focus.
Literal flight realizes immediately after the focus the remote dispersal image latent in the preceding root.

changed_reading.before: Livestock provision ends one topic and human flight begins another.
changed_reading.after: A remote branch lets the last pre-focus root foreshadow group dispersal, with the event's arrival converting latent flight into explicit human flight.

strongest_changes: The third coming reverses the opening attention economy: a neglected visitor's arrival is answered by an arrival no one can neglect.
The event acts as a deadline that closes both voluntary remembrance and the 'not yet' of unfinished command.
The arrival forces individuation by unbinding the closest relations and enclosing each person in a private concern.
The event presents hidden orientation on visible faces, connecting the opening frown to the final uncovered or overlaid surfaces.
summary.what_was_special: The focus has only one branch-backed root, yet repeated جاء and the branchless event noun activate a dense hinge: arrival becomes reversal, compulsion, deadline, material phase-change, relational unbinding, and disclosure without collapsing those readings into one.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus root ص خ خ has no branch inventory, so every sonic claim remains structurally rather than branch supported.
The compelling and presenting readings use side branches whose causative or transitive force is not overt in the intransitive focus form.
The packet does not settle whether the event causes revival, flight, and facial disclosure or only marks their time.
Material pressure, ripening, and livestock-dispersion readings are productive analogies but remain deliberately exploratory across domains.
